frozen_fiche.objective: Rest and smooth quasi-1D nozzle balance
frozen_fiche.physics_numerics: Current C1.0-R3 physics and NUM-001…010, BC-001…008, TS-001…007. Constant-gamma fixtures explicitly test the homogeneous numerical limit, not GEN1 chemical validity.
frozen_fiche.initial_state: gamma1.4,R1: rest rho=p=1,u0. Smooth p0=T01,Mthroat=.3 atx=.5; subsonic area-Mach solution.
frozen_fiche.domain: SI units throughout. NASA5 uses frozen dataset, 300–2200 K and 50 kPa–5 MPa; constant-gamma canonical cases use their stated mathematical domain.
frozen_fiche.mesh_sequence: Uniform N=[50,100,200,400] on x=[0,1] m, exact cell-average initialization; A=1 m².
frozen_fiche.dt_sequence: CFL=[0.2,0.1,0.05]; spatial assessment at 0.05, temporal separation on finest N. Align to end and sampling times.
frozen_fiche.boundary_states: Rest rigid walls; smooth exact stationary states at exterior ghost positions.
frozen_fiche.sampling: Initial and final full cell-average fields plus 101 uniformly spaced times using endpoint alignment. Reference averages use Gauss16/32 with exact wave breaks split; no point-value vs average comparison.
frozen_fiche.independent_reference: Area-Mach A/A*=1/M*[2/(g+1)*(1+(g-1)M²/2)]^((g+1)/(2*(g-1))); choose subsonic root connected to M=.3 atminA. T=1/(1+.2M²),p=T^3.5,rho=p/T,u=M*sqrt(1.4T). Initialize exact area-weighted averages; independently integrate with Gauss16/32.
frozen_fiche.reference_resolution: Analytic reference evaluated independently in float64 with 80-digit arithmetic spot checks. Reference absolute error must be below 10% of the smallest applicable threshold; otherwise REFERENCE_NOT_QUALIFIED.
frozen_fiche.metric: Maximum timewise absolute error divided by declared scale, plus L1/L2 and observed log2 refinement order. Ledger is final−initial−external flux−physical source, scaled by initial absolute inventory plus absolute throughput plus nonzero reference inventory.
frozen_fiche.threshold: Rest max abs(u),abs(p-1)≤1e-10; smooth N400 L1rho≤2e-6 and order≥1.8; ledger with physical geometric force≤1e-10.
frozen_fiche.failure: IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT for violated algebra/input/ledger; VERIFICATION_FAILURE for failed numerical acceptance; REFERENCE_NOT_QUALIFIED if oracle allocation fails. No tolerance changes or scientific choices by adapter.
frozen_fiche.artifacts: Versioned SI input JSON, candidate/ref raw time series, source and environment hashes, actual mesh/dt, all retries, ledgers, normalized metrics/order, PASS/FAIL with reason. No synthetic run is experimental validation.
